name: Sentient OS
long_description:
Truly personal AI requires running inference on your life, every day. In the cloud, that’s expensive and a privacy nightmare. On your own chip, it’s free and private.

Our custom inference stack, built on a LiteRT-LM fork, runs on Macs with just 8 GB of RAM. Every night, Sentient’s on-device models process your emails, messages, Granola transcripts, files, and more, building a rich personal knowledge base on your Mac.

Your projects, conversations, commitments, and preferences. Context you’d never have the time to type into a chatbot.

That understanding powers three ways to get work done:

Sidekick: click your Mac’s notch and say “finish this for me.” It already has your context and gets to work across your apps and browser with its own cursor, while you keep working.

Proactive intelligence: wake up to work already prepared. The reply you forgot, drafted. The subscription renewing tomorrow, caught. The report you promised, ready for review. Sentient waits for your approval before acting.

Double Tap: two taps, two seconds, and the reply you would have written appears, drafted from your personal context and writing style. Just review and send.

Open source and built with privacy at its core. Over 30 enterprises use Sentient already.

Our alpha reached 4,000+ users in its first week with $0 marketing. Our launch was the top post of the month on r/macapps.

We’ve raised over $1 million with participation from Y Combinator (F26), Afore, Pioneer Fund, and a16z speedrun’s scout fund.
one_liner: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.

launches.title: Sentient OS: On-device AI that knows you and takes over your work
launches.tagline: On-device AI that understands your life overnight, takes on tasks with its own cursor, and drafts replies in your voice in two taps.
launches.body:
We’re Aditya and Jesai, 18 and 20, and we’re building **Sentient OS: on-device AI that understands your life overnight, so you can hand off work in an instant.**

<https://youtu.be/if5vwTbmvVw>

Your life is scattered across emails, messages, notes, and files. While you sleep, Sentient’s on-device LLM connects the dots, building the personal context you’d never have time to type into a chatbot.

That understanding powers two magical experiences:

**1. Your replies, in two taps.**

Click into an email or message reply box and double tap your right Command key. Sentient drafts the reply you would have written, drawing on your personal context and writing style, right where you’re typing.

No more spending your morning writing 15 email replies from scratch. Just review and send.

**2. Hand off the work you’re already doing.**

Click your Mac’s notch and say **“finish this for me.”** Sidekick picks up where you left off, working across your apps and browser with its own cursor, while you keep working.

Follow up after a meeting, prepare an investor update, or finish an application. It brings your personal context into the task, so you can hand off the work without explaining your life first.

**Why we’re building on-device**

We’re obsessed with pushing the limits of on-device LLMs and the experiences they unlock. Running inference on the chip you already own lets an AI spend hours understanding your life every night without a cloud inference bill.

Our custom inference stack builds that understanding on Apple silicon Macs with just **8 GB of RAM**. Your knowledge lives in an editable Markdown folder on your Mac. You can read it, correct it, and use it with other AI tools.

Sentient is **open source**. Your connected local sources are analyzed on-device. Sidekick can use your existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription, and cloud-powered features receive context for the task. You can also choose compatible local models.

**10,000+ people already use Sentient**, including users at 130+ companies such as Adobe.

[**Download Sentient for Mac**](https://sentient-os.ai/). Try Double Tap on a reply you’ve been putting off, or hand Sidekick something that’s taking time away from building. We’d love to hear what you hand off first :)

\-- Jesai & Aditya
